description: This file defines the internal sealed class SerializationCallbacksFactory within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It creates and manages delegates for serialization callback methods marked with specific attributes, supporting both reference and value types, and uses reflection and dynamic method generation to invoke these callbacks during serialization and deserialization processes.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacksFactory
classes.description: Creates delegates for calling methods marked with serialization attributes, managing caching and dynamic invocation for serialization callbacks.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacks<TDelegate>
classes.description: Holds delegates for serialization callback methods such as OnDeserializing, OnDeserialized, OnSerializing, and OnSerialized.

methods.name: GetReferenceTypeCallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves serialization callbacks for reference types, utilizing a cache.

methods.name: GetValueTypeCallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves serialization callbacks for value types, supporting generic owner and delegate types.

methods.name: CreateTypedCallbacks
methods.description: Creates serialization callback delegates by inspecting methods with reflection and attributes.

methods.name: GetSerializationMethod
methods.description: Generates a DynamicMethod to invoke a serialization callback, handling value and reference types.
